follows: Completed eight-run somalia_mechanism_20261126 diagnostic; this is a separate bounded instrumentation follow-up, not an expanded ablation search.
question: Does the Somali wind-turning intervention change the moisture-transport wind as well as the surface wind, and which signed terms of the model's local moisture equation sustain the remaining rainfall? How does the Sahara control's equation differ?
budget: Exactly three instrumented replays of already completed parameter/region combinations. No new settings, fits, extra candidates, regional exclusions or unopened data. Same fresh r58 parameters,56km grid and1100km pad. All valid scored cells are traced; no favourable-cell selection.
instrumentation: Existing ClimateModel.trace_cells and run(diagnose_moisture=True) hooks only; do not edit any physical source or shared cache while W18c runs. Capture actual moisture_u/v alongside surface u/v, water/saturation, rain/evaporation, soil, rain-driver coefficients, damping, source/sink rates and existing moisture_terms outputs. Trace drivers retain their model units and are not turned into rainfall fractions.
replay_controls: All three full physical T/P/E/W/u/v outputs, after the production monthly mapping, must exactly match their completed somalia_mechanism counterparts. Case identities must match; all numerical certificates must pass. Demonstrate instrumentation changes no physical results. Preserve failures and do not weaken these checks.
time_mapping: Join trace records to the model's stored day coordinates, requiring a complete unique25-step match; do not assume trace append order or assign steps to months by nearest timestamp. Use production monthly_weights with12 equal-length model months. Preserve all25 raw steps and12 monthly summaries.
equation_scope: r58 uses stationary concentration-form upwind transport, not conservative flux-form transport. Report signed local advection, diffusion, eddy exchange, evaporation, total column drying and convergence import against rain. Monsoon drying is a SUBSET of total column drying and must not be added twice. This audits the selected discrete local equation; it is not a conservative regional boundary-flux budget or an observed atmospheric attribution.
closure_check: Reconstruct local residual from saved component fields and compare stored signed residual, allowing float32 export rounding. Keep mean absolute instantaneous residual before aggregation; report max absolute residual divided by max(rain+abs(evaporation),0.1mm/day) against the existing0.01 equation tolerance. If that corroboration fails, report it explicitly and make no closure claim; do not tune a parameter to fix a diagnostic.
outputs: Raw trace/operator packet, complete monthly scalar tables, signed annual equation totals, surface-versus-transport wind comparison, full certificate/source receipts, independently checked diagnostic figure and concise findings. No claim that raw driver coefficients add linearly to rain.
W18c: Continues independently on its frozen objective/budget and gates. No effect on finalist selection or sealed-AA access. This prepares the next structural question after W18c closes.
